sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: What do we say to our teacher when we enter the classroom in the morning?
In the story 'The Cap Seller and the Monkeys', who took the caps?
What did Anandi see outside her window?
Which animal do we see on a farm that gives us milk?
Fill in the blank with the correct Article: I eat ___ apple every day.
Ravi is a good boy. ___ plays football.
Which of these is a healthy habit?
During which season do we wear warm woollen clothes?
Where is the bird if it is sitting on top of the tree?
According to the poem 'Two Little Hands', what do the two little hands do? (Write in maximum 10 words)
questions.answer: Two little hands go clap, clap, clap.

questions.question_text: Rewrite this sentence using a capital letter and a full stop: 'my name is rahul' (Write in maximum 10 words)
Name any two colours that you can see in Anandi's rainbow. (Write in maximum 10 words)
How did the cap seller get his caps back from the monkeys? (Write in maximum 15 words)
questions.answer: He threw his own cap on the ground, and the monkeys copied him.

questions.question_text: Write the names of two unhealthy foods we should not eat every day. (Write in maximum 10 words)

sections.section_name: Section C - Grammar & Matching (Fill in the Blanks)

questions.question_text: Match the Describing Words with the correct Naming Words: 1) Big 2) Hot 3) Red || a) Apple b) Elephant c) Sun
Fill in the blanks with correct Action Words (sleep, run, eat): 1. I ____ with my legs. 2. I ____ food when hungry. 3. I ____ in bed at night.
Imagine you are in a garden. Write two short sentences about what you see around you. (Maximum 20 words)
questions.answer: I see green grass and beautiful flowers. There are red butterflies flying everywhere.

questions.question_text: What is your favourite season? Write two lines explaining why you like it. (Maximum 20 words)
questions.answer: My favourite season is summer. I love it because I can eat cold ice cream.
